question: Joint Liability Group is usually an informal group that consists of ________ individuals who seek loans against mutual guarantee.
solution:
The correct answer is __**4-10**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Joint Liability Group**

 
 
• The **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)**, a rural development organisation in India.
 
• It has developed the idea of Joint Liability Groups in 2014 to offer institutional finance to small farmers.
 
• In order to obtain a **loan **from a bank without providing any **collateral**, a Joint **Liability** Group is made up of four to ten individuals from the same **town** or **locality **who share a similar **socioeconomic** background.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **JLGs **can be promoted by Business Facilitators/Correspondents, **NGOs**, **Farmers Clubs**,** Farmers Federations**, **Panchayati Raj Institutions**, **Agricultural **Universities, **Bank Branches**, **PACS**, **Cooperative Societies**, **Individuals**, **mFIs**, and Many **Others**.
 
• A **bank **may choose to provide funding to a **JLG **either directly to the group or to an individual **member**. In either **scenario**, the **loan **balance must be repaid in full by all** JLG members**.
